name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 10 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 13 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 5 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 2.39 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
